name: Lemon-Dill Chicken Soup with Orzo Pasta, Carrot, Celery & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are just starting to soften, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g ground chicken
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and orzo to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until the orzo is tender, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2.84 L chicken or vegetable broth
255 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the orzo is done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Juice lemons into the pot, add dill, and stir to combine the soup. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Enjoy!
